blocks.html:
Decal and Letterings for NorthWest Protection Services

NorthWest Protection Services Ltd. is a company that provides event security services to companies and individuals. They are the largest event security provider in Canada. They have been in business for over 10 years and they have worked with a wide variety of clients, ranging from small private parties to large festivals and events.

NorthWest Protection Services Ltd. wanted to increase their brand visibility by getting decals installed on their Nissan Rogue SUV. They wanted us to put their logo, contact number, and website on the vehicle’s side doors. They also wanted to ensure that these decals would stay on the vehicle for as long as possible—so we used high-quality vinyl from Avery Dennison and 3M that can withstand all kinds of weather conditions.

We were happy to help NorthWest Protection Services Ltd. market themselves by putting their logo, contact number, and website on their vehicle! We know that these decals increased the visibility of this company’s name and helped them gain more clients because now potential customers will see their van driving around town—and be able to easily get in touch with them if need be!

If you would like to personalize your car, truck, boat, or other personal items – as long as it fits into our garage and has a smooth surface, we would love to wrap it! For your inspiration or your next partial wrap with Vinyl Wrap Toronto, do not forget to check out our Portfolio.

Get a Free Quote today by filling out the form and our team will get back to you as soon as possible. You can reach us at 416-746-1381 or email us at info@vinylwraptoronto.com. You can also visit us at 24 Ronson Dr, Unit 1, Etobicoke, ON, M9W1B4.

Don’t forget to follow us on Instagram, Facebook, Twitter, and Pinterest to hear about our special deals, creative wrap projects, and vehicle branding.
